statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0105 is an informational notice that the core2 crate is unmaintained. It names no vulnerability and no patched release. core2 0.4.0 is compiled into libflux through libflate, which flux-core uses. All published core2 versions are yanked. Replacing it needs a change in flux, the Flux query engine that Kapacitor links as libflux.
